summary: Kaniksu National Forest tower built in 1934 as a 40-foot pole with an L-4 cab after a 1931 camp, destroyed in 1962; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1962; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as gone.

events.note: Bob Bond listed as known staff; photo captioned 1950 (Gary Weber collection)
Ryder Chronic listed as known staff; photo captioned 1956

evidence.supports: camp 1931; 40-foot pole L-4 tower built 1934; destroyed 1962
evidence.quote: Established with a camp in 1931, this 40' pole L-4 tower, built in 1934, was destroyed in 1962.

notes_for_editor: Two lookout histories agree on the 1931 camp, 1934 tower and 1962 loss, and on the Kaniksu agency. The Idaho register says Removed with no year. Staff entries come from photo captions and give no dates of tenure beyond the year shown. Elevation 5850 ft per firelookout.com; a search snippet gave about 5,859 ft, which was not read and is not used. No present-day site description or access information found. The brief's gone status and Boundary County check out. Verified 2026-10-10: staff years now described as photo captions, not tenure.
